summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing for StatLine. 19/19 pytest cases pass (auth, subscription, sports, match chart, free-user access control). Playwright smoke covers landing, register->dashboard, Matches tab with track/odds, Match Chart with recharts, Teams tab with roster dialog, and Account tab with Upgrade dialog. All critical flows functional.

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr blocks reserved TLDs like .test/.example - acceptable but worth noting for test data.

issues: Duplicate data-testid: PricingCards in the Account page AND inside UpgradeDialog both render `select-plan-yearly-btn`/`confirm-payment-btn`. Playwright strict mode errors on multi-match. Suggest scoping testids inside the dialog (e.g. dialog-confirm-payment-btn) or conditionally rendering only one.

action_items: (Optional) Disambiguate duplicate data-testids when the same PricingCards component is shown twice (Account page + Upgrade dialog). Either scope by parent or add a prefix variant in the dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: bcrypt + JWT properly used; password_hash and _id stripped from responses (good).
Subscription idempotency: activate_subscription correctly short-circuits when status=active + same plan.

Trial expiry: refresh_and_get_status downgrades expired trials in DB lazily; logic verified by manually setting subscription_status=expired in Mongo (free users get 403 on /api/sports/odds and locked non-FREE leagues).
Odds API integration is real and returning live EPL fixtures; player rosters correctly fall back to source='sample' as documented.
Minor: chart_routes uses datetime field commence_time as nullable string - works but could be typed more strictly.
Minor: pytest.ini hardcodes -n 2 --dist loadscope which collided with -p no:xdist; agents need to use -n 0 for serial runs (documented inline already).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all flows pass; one selector strict-mode issue due to duplicate testid)

test_credentials: Tests register fresh users (test.<uuid>@statlinetest.com / Passw0rd!). Free-user simulation done by directly setting subscription_status='expired' in Mongo (DB=statline_db).
seed_data_creation: No seed data; all test users auto-cleaned via cleanup fixture (regex on email domain).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://teams-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -n 0. pytest.ini enforces xdist; use -n 0 (NOT -p no:xdist). Pydantic EmailStr rejects .test TLD. Free-user 403 path is verified by Mongo-side downgrade. Odds API is live and may rate-limit if abused; cache TTL is 600s for matches and 300s for odds.
rca of the issue: N/A - no critical issues. The Playwright strict-mode failure at the end of UI test is caused by PricingCards component being rendered in two places (Account page and UpgradeDialog) sharing identical data-testids. Workaround: use locator.first or scope to dialog; long-term fix: namespace testids inside the dialog.
